items.html:
James Hall has represented Ireland at Under-13 level right up to the Under-19s. He was part of Ireland's Under-19 squad in the World Cup qualifiers, picking up 4 for 22 in Ireland's big win over Denmark, and has spent time at both Warwickshire's and the European Cricket academies. If he doesn't succeed at international level, which is his dream, he would like to move into coaching.
Will Luke February 2008
